identity: A Jordanian/Egyptian secondary-school history question bank — 20 objective items, one per layout line: 18 multiple-choice with four options each and 2 true/false (صح/خطأ). Topics run from Jordan's parliamentary life, Arab unions and King Hussein to the French Campaign in Egypt, Omar Makram and Muhammad Ali. The scan is dirty: 'بد' for 'بعد' (@196), a duplicated 'الحملة الفرنسية لفرنسية' (@167), and a stray literal 'SEG' token at @299 — the same artifact gold kept inside a segment in doc_46717e5891d4.
law: §S, pure. [stem ‖ option ‖ option ‖ option ‖ option] on every line, and NOTHING inside a stem ever cuts however long it runs (S1) — not the relative clause الذي عانى منه…، not the coordinated و in قيم التكامل و التكافل، not the date عام 1990 م. The stem ends exactly where the options stop being parallel to each other (S-refined, batch 12): at هو، at في، at على، at نتيجة، at جهة، or at the shared head noun the options all modify. Each option is one segment even when it is two or four tokens long (S2), and an option letter welds to its option text (S3).
